title: Sign-ups by channel
description: Categorical color, heavy outlines and hard shadows. Every block rises from zero.

props.name: data
props.description: Categories in caller order, each with a unique nonempty id, label, nonnegative value or null, and optional categorical tone a–d. Default colors follow stable IDs. Invalid numbers are unavailable; zero and missing values retain their labels without a bar. Empty or entirely unavailable datasets show an explicit state. More than six categories receive a horizontally scrollable plot.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Measurement label in the chart heading and tooltips; defaults to Value.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned context such as a reporting period.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats direct labels and tooltips; defaults to en-US numbers with up to two decimal places. Axis ticks use compact numeric notation.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional width in pixels; otherwise fills its container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels; otherwise the plot follows its aspect ratio with a readable minimum height.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed Recharts drawing, subject to reduced motion.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible chart title; defaults to Values by category.
